topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: Ran into something tonight, something I didn't ask for. Found this list, tucked away, like a secret old like pain buried deep. Her handwriting, sharp and neat. Places she wants to see, things she wants to do. None of it with me. It's all tight spaces and cold sweat, the kind that won't dry no matter how hard you wipe. I thought we had it figured, at least until the next rain storm. Should've known better. Now I'm sifting through these words, trying to make sense of a map that leads somewhere I'm not part of. Maybe it's time to get out before the storm really hits.
